items.verbatim: WEDC Investor Tax Credit under the Qualified New Business Venture program, awarded 2022-10-19 to a recipient in City of Viroqua, Vernon County. Industry: Info and Comm (NAICS 511210). Award amount: $3,000,000. Planned project cost: $400,000.
